name: General Appreciation & Faculty Praise
description: Generic positive feedback regarding the brand, specific teachers, and overall platform utility.

name: App Stability & Crash Fixes
description: Technical issues where the app force closes, crashes during form filling, or fails to open entirely.

name: Video Streaming & Playback Performance
description: Issues with video lagging, buffering, recorded lectures not playing, or brightness controls during playback.

name: Course Discovery & Search Navigation
description: Difficulty in finding specific batches, lack of a search bar, and confusing UI for navigating content.

name: Live Class Engagement Tools
description: UI/UX issues within live sessions such as chat distractions, poll glitches, and orientation switching.

name: Support Ticket Resolution & Helpdesk
description: The efficiency and politeness of the customer support team in resolving user queries via calls or tickets.

name: Sales Calls & Telemarketing Frequency
description: Complaints regarding excessive spam calls, harassment from sales teams, and unwanted marketing after login.

name: Book Delivery & Logistics
description: Delays or non-delivery of physical study materials, modules, and tracking issues for printed books.

name: Payments, Refunds & Auto-Renewal
description: Issues with unauthorized auto-debits, failed refund processing, and perceived subscription scams.

name: Test Series & Academic Data Accuracy
description: Missing test results, incorrect syllabus information, and errors in test schedules or performance graphs.

name: Mentorship & 1-on-1 Guidance
description: Problems with assigned mentors not answering calls or difficulty in accessing personalized mentorship features.

name: Account Access & Device Restrictions
description: Frustrations regarding single-device login policies and errors related to non-Play Store app versions.

name: Notification Relevance & Scheduling
description: Complaints about missing class alerts or receiving too many irrelevant motivational/marketing notifications.

name: Study Resources & AI Doubt Solving
description: Feedback on supplementary features like AI tutors, free PYQs, PDF notes, and digital doubt counters.

name: Other / unclear
description: Does not fit any theme or is too vague
